name: Supabase Data Isolation
description: Database-bound authorization and explicit tenant data locality.

sources.title: Supabase Row Level Security guidance
sources.licenseNote: Public documentation reference; no external endorsement claimed.

principles: Put tenant authorization at the strongest data boundary.
Keep compute close to data when that preserves correctness.
tradeoffs: Database policy work requires explicit migrations and tests.
decisionRules: Reject application-layer joins when the database boundary can enforce locality.
